design_overview: A clean, card-based web task manager built around one fast loop: add a task, check it off, filter, delete with confirmation. Indigo primary actions, generous spacing, and clear states keep a new user productive within a minute.

screens.name: Task List
screens.purpose: Home screen to view all tasks, filter by status, complete or uncheck tasks, and start creating a task.

key_components.name: App Header
key_components.styling: White bar with soft shadow, title 'My Tasks' in bold 28px, subtle open-task count 'Open 3' beneath in gray.
key_components.interaction: Static title; stays pinned while list scrolls.

key_components.name: Add Task Button
key_components.styling: Indigo filled rounded button in header right, white label 'New Task', plus icon, 44px height.
key_components.interaction: Opens the New Task screen.

key_components.name: Status Filter Tabs
key_components.styling: Segmented pill chips 'All', 'Active', 'Completed'; selected chip indigo filled with white text, others light gray.
key_components.interaction: Tap refreshes list to show only matching tasks.

key_components.name: Task Card List
key_components.styling: Vertical stack of white rounded cards, 12px gaps, light border and soft shadow, scannable rows.
key_components.interaction: Scrolls; tapping a card opens Task Details.

key_components.name: Task Checkbox
key_components.styling: 24px rounded square, gray outline when open, green fill with white check when complete; 44px touch area.
key_components.interaction: Toggles complete or incomplete instantly and saves status.

key_components.name: Task Title Row
key_components.styling: Bold 16px title, one-line gray description preview; completed tasks show strikethrough and muted color.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens Task Details for that task.

key_components.name: Status Badge
key_components.styling: Small pill: amber tint 'Open' or green tint 'Done', 13px semibold text.
key_components.interaction: Informational; reflects current status.

key_components.name: Quick Add Floating Button
key_components.styling: 56px circular indigo floating button bottom-right with white plus icon and shadow.
key_components.interaction: Opens the New Task screen.

screens.user_flow: Landing screen on app open. Leaves via New Task button to New Task, via task card to Task Details, or via an empty filter to Empty State.

screens.name: New Task
screens.purpose: Create a task with a required title and optional description, with clear validation.

key_components.name: Form Header
key_components.styling: White bar with back arrow label 'Back' and bold title 'New Task'.
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Task List without saving.

key_components.name: Title Input
key_components.styling: Rounded 12px field, 52px high, gray border turning indigo on focus, label 'Title', placeholder 'What do you need to do?'.
key_components.interaction: Tap to type; auto-focused on screen open.

key_components.name: Title Validation Error
key_components.styling: Red 13px message 'Please enter a title' under field; field border turns red.
key_components.interaction: Appears when saving with empty title; no task created.

key_components.name: Description Input
key_components.styling: Multi-line rounded textarea, 120px high, label 'Description (optional)', placeholder 'Add details, notes, or links'.
key_components.interaction: Tap to type optional details.

key_components.name: Character Counter
key_components.styling: Right-aligned gray 13px counter '0 / 100' under title field.
key_components.interaction: Updates live while typing.

key_components.name: Save Task Button
key_components.styling: Full-width indigo button, white bold label 'Save Task', 52px high, rounded 12px.
key_components.interaction: Validates title; saves and returns to Task List with new task.

key_components.name: Cancel Button
key_components.styling: Full-width outlined gray button, label 'Cancel', below the primary action.
key_components.interaction: Discards input and returns to Task List.

key_components.name: Success Toast
key_components.styling: Dark rounded snackbar with green accent bar, text 'Task added'.
key_components.interaction: Shows on Task List after save; dismisses after 3 seconds.

screens.user_flow: Reached from New Task button or floating button on Task List. Saving or cancelling returns to Task List.

screens.name: Task Details
screens.purpose: Review a task's full information, toggle completion, and start deletion.

key_components.name: Details Header
key_components.styling: White bar with 'Back' link and bold title 'Task Details'.
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Task List.

key_components.name: Task Summary Card
key_components.styling: White rounded card, 20px padding, large bold title, status badge, soft shadow.
key_components.interaction: Static summary of selected task.

key_components.name: Description Block
key_components.styling: Body text in card section labeled 'Description'; gray italic 'No description added' when empty.
key_components.interaction: Read-only display.

key_components.name: Created Date Row
key_components.styling: Gray 13px metadata line 'Created Nov 11, 2026' with divider above.
key_components.interaction: Informational only.

key_components.name: Complete Toggle Button
key_components.styling: Full-width green filled button 'Mark as Complete'; when done becomes outlined 'Mark as Incomplete'.
key_components.interaction: Toggles status, saves, updates badge and card.

key_components.name: Delete Task Button
key_components.styling: Full-width outlined red button, red label 'Delete Task', trash icon, 52px high.
key_components.interaction: Opens Delete Confirmation dialog.

key_components.name: Status Change Toast
key_components.styling: Dark snackbar reading 'Marked as complete' with 'Undo' text action in teal.
key_components.interaction: Undo reverts status; auto-dismisses after 4 seconds.

screens.user_flow: Opened by tapping a card on Task List. Leaves via Back to Task List or Delete Task to Delete Confirmation.

screens.name: Delete Confirmation
screens.purpose: Confirm or cancel permanent deletion to prevent accidental loss.

key_components.name: Dim Overlay
key_components.styling: Semi-transparent dark scrim over Task Details, blocks background interaction.
key_components.interaction: Tap outside cancels and closes dialog.

key_components.name: Confirmation Dialog
key_components.styling: White rounded 16px modal, centered, 24px padding, strong shadow, max width 400px.
key_components.interaction: Holds delete and cancel actions.

key_components.name: Dialog Title
key_components.styling: Bold 20px title 'Delete this task?'.
key_components.interaction: Static text.

key_components.name: Task Name Preview
key_components.styling: Gray rounded chip showing selected task title in 16px medium text.
key_components.interaction: Static; confirms which task is affected.

key_components.name: Warning Message
key_components.styling: Amber-tinted 13px note 'This action is permanent and cannot be undone.'
key_components.interaction: Static warning.

key_components.name: Confirm Delete Button
key_components.styling: Red filled button, white label 'Delete', 48px high, rounded 12px.
key_components.interaction: Deletes task permanently; returns to Task List with toast.

key_components.name: Cancel Delete Button
key_components.styling: Light gray outlined button, label 'Keep Task', placed beside delete action.
key_components.interaction: Closes dialog; task unchanged on Task Details.

screens.user_flow: Opens from Delete Task on Task Details. Delete goes to Task List; Keep Task returns to Task Details.

screens.name: Empty State
screens.purpose: Guide users when no tasks exist or a filter returns no results.

key_components.name: List Header
key_components.styling: Same 'My Tasks' header with 'New Task' button for consistency.
key_components.interaction: New Task opens the New Task screen.

key_components.name: Status Filter Tabs
key_components.styling: Pill chips 'All', 'Active', 'Completed'; 'Completed' selected in indigo.
key_components.interaction: Tap switches filter and reloads Task List.

key_components.name: Empty Illustration
key_components.styling: Soft indigo line illustration of an empty checklist on a pale circular backdrop, 160px.
key_components.interaction: Decorative; not interactive.

key_components.name: Empty Title
key_components.styling: Bold 20px centered text 'No completed tasks yet'.
key_components.interaction: Static text.

key_components.name: Empty Helper Text
key_components.styling: Gray centered body text 'Finish a task and it will show up here.'
key_components.interaction: Static text.

key_components.name: Show All Tasks Button
key_components.styling: Outlined indigo button, label 'Show All Tasks', 48px high, rounded.
key_components.interaction: Resets filter and returns to Task List.

key_components.name: Create First Task Button
key_components.styling: Indigo filled button 'Create Your First Task', shown when no tasks exist at all.
key_components.interaction: Opens the New Task screen.

screens.user_flow: Appears on Task List when filter has no matches or no tasks exist. Leaves to Task List or New Task.

ui_components.name: Primary Button
ui_components.styling: Indigo filled, white bold text, 12px radius, 48-52px height, darker on hover and press.

ui_components.name: Secondary Button
ui_components.styling: White background, gray border, dark text, 12px radius.

ui_components.name: Destructive Button
ui_components.styling: Red outline for entry points; red filled inside confirmation dialog.

ui_components.name: Text Input
ui_components.styling: White field, 1px gray border, 12px radius, indigo focus ring, red error border.
ui_components.interaction: Accepts typed text with inline validation.

ui_components.name: Task Card
ui_components.styling: White surface, 16px radius, 1px light border, soft shadow, 16px padding.

ui_components.name: Checkbox
ui_components.styling: 24px rounded square, gray outline, green filled when checked, 44px hit area.

ui_components.name: Filter Chip
ui_components.styling: Pill shape, 36px height; selected indigo filled, unselected light gray.

ui_components.name: Status Badge
ui_components.styling: Pill with tinted background: amber for Open, green for Done.

ui_components.name: Modal Dialog
ui_components.styling: White 16px radius panel over dark scrim with strong shadow.
ui_components.interaction: Blocks background until action or dismissal.

ui_components.name: Toast
ui_components.styling: Dark rounded snackbar with white text and optional teal action.

responsive_design: Mobile-first single column up to 600px. On tablet and desktop, content centers in a 720px column with a modal-style form, keeping cards and touch targets unchanged.
accessibility: WCAG AA contrast, 44px minimum touch targets, visible focus rings, labeled inputs, errors announced via aria-live, checkbox state not conveyed by color alone, full keyboard support.
animations: Checkbox check scales in over 150ms, completed titles fade to strikethrough, deleted cards collapse over 200ms, modals fade and scale in, toasts slide up.
icons: Line icons in a consistent 2px stroke from the allowed set: plus for add, filter for status tabs, edit for inputs, trash for deletion, home for back navigation.
